source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: Warnings on that page give different actions and only the reverse curve requires slowing and keeping right without passing while signal ahead and median start and added lane and side road and rough surface and cross traffic have their own instructions.
corrections.note: Narrowed slow keep right no pass to reverse curve only.

corrections.corrected_statement: Barrels cushion solid obstacles and high crash areas and a hearing impaired flag on a bicycle means slow down while the same flag on a vehicle only alerts others and orange is the basic color for work zone devices like signs and barricades and panels and drums and cones and tubes and arrow panels and flaggers and drivers should be ready to slow or stop and change lanes and watch for workers and most work signs are diamond shaped with a few rectangular and fines double for violations where workers are present.
corrections.note: Limited slowing order to bicycle flag and fixed orange and fines wording.

corrections.corrected_statement: Reverse curves and sharp turns and gradual curves require slowing and keeping right without passing while winding roads require driving slowly and carefully without passing but do not require keeping right.
corrections.note: Removed keep right from winding road requirement.

corrections.corrected_statement: Orange is the basic color for work zone devices and traffic fines double for violations that occur in construction zones where workers are present.
corrections.note: Changed every device to basic color wording.

corrections.corrected_statement: Signal when changing lanes, turning, pulling from parking, slowing or stopping, entering or leaving a highway, or pulling over, but signal continuously for at least one hundred feet only before turning or stopping and turn off the signal after the turn is complete.
corrections.note: Limited the one hundred foot continuous signal rule to turning or stopping.

corrections.corrected_statement: Never drive on the left where signs or markings forbid it, where there are two or more lanes each way, within one hundred feet of intersections railroad crossings bridges viaducts or tunnels, or on hills curves or places with limited vision, except when passing on a two or three lane street or on a one way street or when the right side is blocked.
corrections.note: Added missing no passing closures and lane limits on the exception.

corrections.corrected_statement: When passing make sure the way is clear, signal before changing lanes, tap your horn only when necessary, and avoid cutting in too quickly when returning, because improper passing often causes deadly head on crashes.
corrections.note: Limited horn use to when necessary and softened crash outcome to often.

corrections.corrected_statement: You may pass on the right only where safe when the road is clear and wide enough for two or more lanes each way, when on a one way road, or on a paved shoulder past a vehicle that is slowing or stopped or disabled or preparing to turn left, and never by driving off the paved portion.
corrections.note: Added lane width condition and disabled and left turn shoulder cases.

corrections.corrected_statement: When being passed do not increase speed and stay in your lane while moving as far right as you can only when being passed on the left where lanes are not marked, and when passing do not linger in blind spots but either pass or slow down.
corrections.note: Added left pass and unmarked lane condition and pass or slow down rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Look behind and to both sides before changing lanes, move into the proper lane early or go straight if you cannot get in within one half block, signal at least one hundred feet before turning, and if using a hand signal hold it until others know your intent but release it to use both hands for the turn.
corrections.note: Added behind and side checks and corrected hand signal release rule.

corrections.corrected_statement: Nearly half of flash flood deaths involve vehicles, with six inches of water causing loss of control and possible stalling, twelve inches floating many cars, two feet of rushing water carrying away pickups and sport utility vehicles, hidden road damage collapsing under weight, stalled drivers leaving quickly for higher ground by choosing another route, floating beginning when buoyancy force is greater than vehicle weight, and modern roundabouts reducing severe intersection crashes by an average of eighty percent.
corrections.note: Changed mostly to nearly half and corrected six inch loss of control wording.

corrections.corrected_statement: Bicycles count as vehicles with full rights and duties, ride beyond right lanes on one-way multi-lane streets and car-pathed left turns, earn motorist merges on right turns without cut-across moves, hug right only in safely shareable lanes, claim full lanes to pass, turn left, dodge hazards, or survive narrow lanes, and crash most when cars left-hook oncoming riders, right-hook their paths, or pull from stops across their right-of-way.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but stop sign pullout is printed on the next page.

corrections.corrected_statement: You must use headlights from thirty minutes after sunset until thirty minutes before sunrise or when people or vehicles cannot be seen clearly for at least one thousand feet, using low beams within five hundred feet of an oncoming vehicle or within three hundred feet when following another vehicle.
corrections.note: Added the thirty minute after sunset to thirty minute before sunrise timing.

corrections.corrected_statement: Right lanes pace slow, middle and left lanes pace fast or pass, and exits stage early with signs one thousand yards out.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but lane assignments are printed on the prior page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Skids steer into slides, brake failures ease parking brakes with low gears, departures slow before re-entering, and flats stop straight, all without slammed brakes.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but steer into skid is printed on the prior page.

corrections.corrected_statement: The most common car motorcycle crash is a car turning left in front of a motorcycle, motorcyclists are often hidden in blind spots, and drivers should check mirrors and blind spots, signal intentions, and allow motorcycles a full lane.
corrections.note: Changed always to often and clarified full lane and signal protection.

corrections.corrected_statement: Bikes trail four to six seconds back, rails demand never-on-tracks discipline, and cycles claim full lanes against hooks and pullouts.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but stop sign pullout is printed on the next page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Only blind partially blind or disabled people may carry a white cane on a public street and no one may stand in the road to ask for rides contributions or business except for an authorized charitable contribution allowed by the local authority.
corrections.note: Added partially blind to white cane eligibility and clarified the solicitation ban and charity exception.

corrections.corrected_statement: Giving a false name to an officer may lead to arrest and fleeing an officer brings higher penalties if you use a vehicle or cause injury while road rage causes hundreds of injuries and deaths each year.
corrections.note: Only fleeing is described with higher penalties, not lying or road rage.

corrections.corrected_statement: Drivers must watch for pedestrians and give them the right of way at uncontrolled intersections and on a WALK signal and on a green light where there is no pedestrian signal and after entering the crosswalk if the light changes, Yield Here to Pedestrians signs are used before yield lines at marked crosswalks crossing uncontrolled multilane roadways, In Street Pedestrian Crossing signs are placed in the road on the center line or lane line or median island and not on either side of the road while Overhead Pedestrian Crossing signs are placed over the roadway at the crosswalk.
corrections.note: Fixed placement to limit roadside ban to In-Street signs and place Overhead signs over roadway.

corrections.corrected_statement: When turning left always yield to any vehicle coming straight through from the other direction, when approaching a through street from a street ending at the intersection stop and yield to vehicles on the through street, and when entering or crossing a road from a private road alley building or driveway stop before the sidewalk and yield to all approaching vehicles and pedestrians.
corrections.note: Removed without stopping and limited pedestrian yield to private exits.

corrections.corrected_statement: Lit emergency runs demand a right-edge stop or slowed clear path with five hundred feet of following room, while lit stopped vehicles demand a lane change or sharp slowdown.
corrections.note: Stopped-vehicle lane vacate and slowdown rule is printed on page 29 not page 28.

corrections.corrected_statement: Class C covers lighter vehicles and small trailers and certified three wheel autocycles but never motorcycles costing thirty three dollars total as an adult and sixteen dollars total at sixteen with education and six dollars total at fifteen with hardship while Class M first requires passing a state approved motorcycle course with under eighteen entrants showing classroom education or a learner license or a valid Class C.
corrections.note: Changed plus to or to show three alternatives.

corrections.corrected_statement: Filers prove identity and Social Security and fingerprints and medical fitness and lawful presence while surrendering any valid out of state driver license and every exam and conviction and crash stays on the permanent record and original filers insure each owned vehicle to Texas minimums or state none qualifies.
corrections.note: Changed foreign licenses to out of state driver license.

corrections.corrected_statement: Reinstatement costs one hundred dollars for mandatory suspensions and revocations and drug education with some mandatory suspensions also requiring an SR twenty two filing and one hundred twenty five dollars only for administrative license revocations while mandatory suspension opens on driving while intoxicated and drug offenses and intoxication assault and other listed convictions.
corrections.note: Limited one hundred twenty five dollars to ALR cases.

corrections.corrected_statement: Minors face hearing suspension only for juvenile court orders and unpaid fines or contempt and two or more separate traffic convictions within twelve months under age eighteen while delinquent conduct triggers automatic under twenty one suspension and administrative license revocation costs one hundred twenty five dollars and applies at zero point zero eight adult failure and any refusal and any under twenty one detection and cancellation follows out of state actions and lost parental approval and missing information or entitlement or education and false statements.
corrections.note: Moved delinquent conduct to automatic suspension.
